description: Level-3 MOM SegmentRequirement (ISA-95 Part 2 / B2MML OperationsRequest.SegmentRequirement) = the PLAN per manufacturing stage. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-requirement.md, description.

properties.name: segment_requirement_no
properties.description: Identity of the SegmentRequirement (join key): its number within its production order, <production_order_no>.<operation number> — as the source system keys an operation (order + operation number; OPEN-0350 round 4).

properties.name: production_order_ref
properties.description: FK to ProductionOrder.production_order_no (PART_OF). The OperationsRequest to which this segment target belongs.

properties.name: process_segment_ref
properties.description: FK to ProcessSegment.process_segment_no (FOR_PROCESS_SEGMENT). Which manufacturing stage (= plant = Function) is planned here.

properties.name: sequence
properties.description: Sequence of this segment within the order.

properties.name: material_ref
properties.description: FK to Article.article_no (REQUIRES_MATERIAL) = MaterialRequirement.MaterialDefinitionID. The target material of this stage.

properties.name: material_use
properties.description: ISA-95 MaterialRequirement.MaterialUse — the ROLE of the material in this stage. Encodes the 'Being Consumed/Produced/Tested/Moved'.

properties.name: qty_planned
properties.description: Planned quantity of this material role (target). Counterpart to SegmentResponse.qty_actual.

properties.name: unit_of_measure
properties.description: Unit of measure of qty_planned (UN/CEFACT code recommended).

properties.name: equipment_ref
properties.description: FK to Machine.machine_id (REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT; Machine ≡ Unit level) = EquipmentRequirement.EquipmentID. The target equipment of the stage.

properties.name: planned_start_time
properties.description: Planned stage start (target).

properties.name: planned_end_time
properties.description: Planned stage end (target).

properties.name: operations_definition_ref
properties.description: The OperationsDefinition (FOR_OPERATIONS_DEFINITION; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → OperationsDefinition). Optional.

properties.name: operations_definition_version
properties.description: The version of the operations definition this order / response ran with, where the source's definition id carries none (a routing number with its own change state). Empty when the id itself names the version.

properties.name: operations_segment_ref
properties.description: The OperationsSegment (FOR_OPERATIONS_SEGMENT; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → OperationsSegment). Optional.

properties.name: parent_segment_requirement_ref
properties.description: The SegmentRequirement this SegmentRequirement is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement MADE_UP_OF SegmentRequirement). Optional.

properties.name: segment_response_ref
properties.description: The SegmentResponse (REQUESTS_SEGMENT_RESPONSE; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → SegmentResponse). Optional.

properties.name: equipment_class_ref
properties.description: The EquipmentClass (REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → EquipmentClass). Optional.

properties.name: material_class_ref
properties.description: The MaterialClass (REQUIRES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → MaterialClass). Optional.

properties.name: material_lot_ref
properties.description: The MaterialLot (REQUIRES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → MaterialLot). Optional.

properties.name: quant_ref
properties.description: The Quant (REQUIRES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → MaterialSubLot). Optional.

properties.name: person_ref
properties.description: The Person (REQUIRES_PERSONNEL; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → Person). Optional.

properties.name: personnel_class_ref
properties.description: The PersonnelClass (REQUIRES_PERSONNEL; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → PersonnelClass). Optional.

properties.name: tool_ref
properties.description: The Tool (REQUIRES_PHYSICAL_ASSET; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → PhysicalAsset). Optional.

properties.name: physical_asset_class_ref
properties.description: The PhysicalAssetClass (REQUIRES_PHYSICAL_ASSET; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → PhysicalAssetClass). Optional.

properties.name: test_specification_ref
properties.description: The TestSpecification (TESTED_BY; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → TestSpecification). Optional.

properties.name: operations_type
properties.description: ISA-95 operations type (B2MML OperationsType; Part 3/4: which MOM area the object belongs to; audit M1). A source without the column sets the constant of the profile's momDomain (columnMappings const).

relationships.description: The OperationsRequest that contains this segment target.
The planned manufacturing stage (= plant = Function).
The target material (MaterialDefinition); role via material_use.
The target equipment of the stage (Machine ≡ Unit level, consolidation 2026-07-15 — the source fkColumn carries machine ids).

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 2 OperationsRequest.SegmentRequirement = PLAN per ProcessSegment, with MaterialRequirement (MaterialUse=role) + EquipmentRequirement. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-requirement.md, isa95 › note.
isa95.mappingNote: sequence is carried by B2MML through the order of SegmentRequirement in OperationsRequest, not as a field. Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent). PLM as-built (owner 29.10.2026): operations_definition_version names the state that was built where the source's id carries none; B2MML references a definition by its ID alone (an ID means one state), so there is no field for it — an extension, never part of the key.

keyStability.note: production_order_no + operation_number are the ERP's own primary key of the operation row (erp-segment-requirements primaryKeyColumns); the key moves only when the ERP row does.
